title: Model ML Integrates with Entropia
body_markdown:
Model ML is excited to announce our partnership with[Entropia](https://entropia.io/) , bringing Entropia’s agentic data rooms into Model ML.


Entropia is an AI-native virtual data room for M&A that does more than store your documents. Entropia’s autonomous agents act like active collaborators who can read entire files, run queries, and surface discrepancies. Entropia’s agents can also perform actions within the data room such as data redaction, file preparation, and translation.


Through the MCP, Model ML users will be able to access Entropia’s agentic data rooms directly in the Model ML platform where they’re already working. No need to download documents or upload screenshots.


“We're excited to partner with Model ML, an AI platform many banks already trust. Entropia is a data room designed to support M&A professionals with AI, and that design extends beyond our own walls: we provide our partners with the same deep read and write tooling our own agents use, so Model ML users get the best of both worlds without leaving their platform.”
Pierre-Louis Corteel, CEO at Entropia.


”Our partnership with Entropia is a meaningful addition to the Model ML platform for our M&A users. Access to Entropia’s agentic data rooms directly in the Model ML platform means that our users can harness the full power of Entropia’s agent-native platform without disrupting their existing workflows”
Chaz Englander, CEO at Model ML


Now available to Model ML users with active Entropia data rooms today.
